modal.tapPicture: Tap the picture matching the cat litter you pour into your box:
modal.calibrationNote: The physical box uses weight to estimate fill level. If you see an unexpected low-litter warning after filling, ensure the box is on a hard flat floor and tap Zero / Tare Scale on an empty drum, or use the lighter Pawbby Natural profile.

lockModal.title: Screen Lock Warning
lockModal.desc1: Locking the screen disables all physical button presses on the box to prevent accidental presses by children or pets.
lockModal.desc2: If Pawbby Reborn loses connection, your Wi-Fi changes, or the daemon goes offline while locked, you may be completely locked out from controlling or unlocking the machine from its physical controls.
lockModal.desc3: Pawbby Reborn and its developers take NO liability in case this locks out or bricks your machine. Proceed at your own risk.
lockModal.confirm: I Understand the Risk, Lock Buttons

natural.name: Pawbby Natural
natural.label: Plant-based starch pellets
natural.tip: Lowest weight threshold. Recommended default if using lightweight or flushable litter to avoid false low-litter warnings.

tofu.name: Tofu Litter
tofu.label: Flushable cylindrical rods
tofu.tip: Standard cylindrical pea/tofu rods. Ensures proper sifting speed and weight tracking.

bentonite.name: Bentonite Clay
bentonite.label: Classic clumping sand
bentonite.tip: Requires a denser fill (~3.8–4.5 kg). If your box triggers a low litter alert with light clay, switch to Pawbby Natural or tare the scale.

mixed.name: Mixed Blend
mixed.label: Tofu rods + clay granules
mixed.tip: Composite blend of tofu pellets and bentonite granules. Balanced weight profile.

actions.emptyDesc: Dump all litter into waste bin
